set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 6-7. Keep FmriDataset, model descriptions, and fit plans pure; introduce checked OpenedDataset[F], ScalafimRuntime.openDataset, domain adapters for volume/surface alignment, and explicit effectful model/fit/MVPA execution boundaries. Then prove the same decoder unchanged through memory, LNA, and Zarr with axis-keyed receipts and transactional publication. Close only when no async or browser source is hidden by a blocking facade, segmentation and exact-grid behavior remain unchanged, runtime assembly is resource-safe, downstream behavior gates pass, locality claims conform to observed reads, and injected Zarr write failure never publishes. Failure of the cross-format proof blocks Track D.
